course_title: Installer et vérifier ELVIS V2 Operator Preview
approval_requirement: Explicit user approval of the exact Studio preview and its SHA-256
raw_media_policy: Keep originals outside Git; retain an immutable private copy
required_session_setup_commands: test -z "$(docker ps -aq --filter label=com.docker.compose.project="$PROJECT")" && test -z "$(docker network ls -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project="$PROJECT")" && test -z "$(docker volume ls -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project="$PROJECT")" && BASELINE_CONTAINERS_SHA256="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}\t{{.Image}}' | LC_ALL=C sort | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')" && test -n "$BASELINE_CONTAINERS_SHA256" && export BASELINE_CONTAINERS_SHA256

captures.title: Release GitHub v2.0.0-alpha.2
captures.capture_environment: Public GitHub release page in a clean browser profile

captures.title: Prérequis Linux, architecture et Docker Compose
captures.exact_command: uname -m && docker version --format '{{.Server.Version}}' && docker compose version --short && gh --version | head -1 && gh attestation verify --help >/dev/null && printf 'gh-attestation: available\n'

captures.title: Téléchargement des six artefacts de release
captures.exact_command: gh release download v2.0.0-alpha.2 --repo cluster2600/ELVIS --pattern 'elvis-v2-operator-*.tar.gz' --pattern 'elvis-v2-operator-*.spdx.json' --pattern 'IMAGE_DIGEST.txt' --pattern 'SHA256SUMS' --pattern '*.intoto.jsonl' && expected="$(printf '%s\n' IMAGE_DIGEST.txt SHA256SUMS elvis-v2-operator-v2.0.0-alpha.2-linux-amd64.spdx.json elvis-v2-operator-v2.0.0-alpha.2-linux-arm64.spdx.json elvis-v2-operator-v2.0.0-alpha.2.intoto.jsonl elvis-v2-operator-v2.0.0-alpha.2.tar.gz | LC_ALL=C sort)" && actual="$(find . -maxdepth 1 -type f -print | sed 's#^./##' | LC_ALL=C sort)" && test "$actual" = "$expected" && printf '%s\n' "$actual"

captures.exact_command: test ! -e "$ENV_FILE" && install -m 0600 "$BUNDLE/v2-preview.env.example" "$ENV_FILE" && install -d -m 0700 "$OPERATOR_DIR" && test -z "$(find "$OPERATOR_DIR" -mindepth 1 -print -quit)" && ELVIS_V2_OPERATOR_IMAGE="$IMAGE" ELVIS_V2_OPERATOR_DIR="$OPERATOR_DIR" ELVIS_V2_OPERATOR_UID=65532 ELVIS_V2_OPERATOR_GID=65532 docker compose --project-name "$PROJECT" --env-file "$ENV_FILE" -f "$COMPOSE_FILE" config --quiet && services="$(ELVIS_V2_OPERATOR_IMAGE="$IMAGE" ELVIS_V2_OPERATOR_DIR="$OPERATOR_DIR" ELVIS_V2_OPERATOR_UID=65532 ELVIS_V2_OPERATOR_GID=65532 docker compose --project-name "$PROJECT" --env-file "$ENV_FILE" -f "$COMPOSE_FILE" config --services)" && images="$(ELVIS_V2_OPERATOR_IMAGE="$IMAGE" ELVIS_V2_OPERATOR_DIR="$OPERATOR_DIR" ELVIS_V2_OPERATOR_UID=65532 ELVIS_V2_OPERATOR_GID=65532 docker compose --project-name "$PROJECT" --env-file "$ENV_FILE" -f "$COMPOSE_FILE" config --images)" && test "$services" = operator && test "$images" = "$IMAGE" && printf '%s\n%s\n' "$services" "$images"

captures.title: Pull de l'image par digest immuable
captures.exact_command: DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR="$(mktemp -d /tmp/elvis-v2-docker-config.XXXXXX)" && cleanup_docker_config() { case "$DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR" in /tmp/elvis-v2-docker-config.*) test -d "$DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR" && find "$DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR" -depth -delete ;; *) return 1 ;; esac; } && trap cleanup_docker_config EXIT && umask 077 && printf '{}\n' > "$DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR/config.json" && env -u DOCKER_AUTH_CONFIG -u REGISTRY_AUTH_FILE DOCKER_CONFIG="$DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR" ELVIS_V2_OPERATOR_IMAGE="$IMAGE" ELVIS_V2_OPERATOR_DIR="$OPERATOR_DIR" ELVIS_V2_OPERATOR_UID=65532 ELVIS_V2_OPERATOR_GID=65532 docker compose --project-name "$PROJECT" --env-file "$ENV_FILE" -f "$COMPOSE_FILE" pull operator && docker image inspect --format '{{.Os}}/{{.Architecture}}' "$IMAGE" && cleanup_docker_config && trap - EXIT && printf 'registry_auth=anonymous\n'
captures.capture_environment: Sanitised Linux amd64 demonstration terminal; anonymous public registry pull
captures.source_file_or_url: Public GHCR image referenced by IMAGE_DIGEST.txt

captures.title: Durcissement Compose, aucun port publié ni volume nommé
captures.exact_command: ELVIS_V2_OPERATOR_IMAGE="$IMAGE" ELVIS_V2_OPERATOR_DIR="$OPERATOR_DIR" ELVIS_V2_OPERATOR_UID=65532 ELVIS_V2_OPERATOR_GID=65532 docker compose --project-name "$PROJECT" --env-file "$ENV_FILE" -f "$COMPOSE_FILE" config --format json | docker run --rm -i --network none --read-only --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --pids-limit 64 -e EXPECTED_OPERATOR_DIR="$OPERATOR_DIR" --entrypoint python "$IMAGE" -c 'import json,os,sys; service=json.load(sys.stdin)["services"]["operator"]; user=str(service.get("user") or ""); volumes=service.get("volumes") or []; assert user=="65532:65532"; assert service.get("read_only") is True; assert service.get("cap_drop")==["ALL"]; assert service.get("security_opt")==["no-new-privileges:true"]; assert service.get("pids_limit")==64; assert service.get("tmpfs")==["/tmp:size=16m,mode=1777"]; assert not service.get("ports"); assert len(volumes)==1; volume=volumes[0]; assert volume.get("type")=="bind"; assert volume.get("source")==os.environ["EXPECTED_OPERATOR_DIR"]; assert volume.get("target")=="/run/operator"; assert volume.get("read_only") is True; safe={"user":user,"read_only":True,"cap_drop":["ALL"],"security_opt":["no-new-privileges:true"],"pids_limit":64,"tmpfs":["/tmp:size=16m,mode=1777"],"published_ports":[],"volume_types":["bind"],"volume_targets":["/run/operator"],"volume_read_only":[True]}; print(json.dumps(safe,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":")))'
